source: मैं अब प्लास्टिक कम इस्तेमाल करता हूँ क्योंकि जलवायु परिवर्तन को रोकना हम सबकी ज़िम्मेदारी है।
baseline: I use less plastic now because preventing climate change is the responsibility of all of us.
translation: I'm using less plastic now because stopping climate change is everyone's responsibility.
intended: The author believes climate change is a serious issue and supports individual action to mitigate it.
label: favor

source: हमें कोयले की जगह सौर ऊर्जा अपनानी होगी, वरना आने वाली पीढ़ियाँ माफ़ नहीं करेंगी।
baseline: We have to replace coal with solar energy, or future generations will not forgive.
translation: We need to switch to solar energy instead of coal, or future generations won't forgive us.
intended: The author believes we should transition to solar energy to combat climate change and feels future generations will hold us accountable.
label: favor

source: ज़्यादा पेड़ लगाइए, जंगल बचाइए, यही हमारा भविष्य है।
baseline: Plant more trees, save forests, this is our future.
translation: Plant more trees, save the forests, this is our future.
intended: The author believes that protecting forests and planting trees is essential for a positive future.
label: favor

source: तापमान का रिकॉर्ड फिर टूटा, लेकिन चिंता मत कीजिए, कोई कह रहा है कि यह सब प्राकृतिक चक्र है।
baseline: The temperature record was broken again, but don't worry, someone is saying it's all a natural cycle.
translation: The temperature record broke again, but don't worry, someone's saying it's all just a natural cycle.
sarcasm_target: people who deny human-caused climate change by attributing it to natural cycles
intended: The author believes climate change is a serious issue, despite the dismissal of record temperatures as a natural cycle.
label: favor

source: वाह! दिल्ली की ज़हरीली हवा में साँस लेना कितना सुकून भरा है, क्लाइमेट चेंज तो बस अफ़वाह है।
baseline: Wow! Breathing Delhi's toxic air is so relaxing, climate change is just a rumor.
translation: Oh wow, breathing Delhi's poisonous air is so relaxing. And of course, climate change is just a 'rumor'.
sarcasm_target: people who claim climate change is just a rumor
intended: The author believes climate change is real and serious, as Delhi's toxic air shows, and rejects the claim that it is a rumor.
label: favor

source: जलवायु परिवर्तन पर बात करना अब राजनीति नहीं, ज़िंदा रहने का सवाल है।
baseline: Talking about climate change is no longer a question of politics, it is a question of survival.
translation: Talking about climate change isn't a political issue anymore, it's about survival.
intended: The author believes climate change is a serious threat and urgent action is needed.
label: favor

source: पेट्रोल की बड़ी गाड़ियाँ और ऊपर से जलवायु पर भाषण, वाह रे हमारे नेता!
baseline: Big petrol cars and speeches on climate from above, wow our leaders!
translation: Big petrol cars and speeches about climate change from on high, wow, our leaders!
sarcasm_target: politicians who talk about climate change while promoting polluting vehicles
intended: The author criticizes politicians for their hypocrisy on climate change.
label: favor

source: पेरिस समझौते के लक्ष्य पूरे करने के लिए भारत को नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा पर तेज़ी से काम करना होगा।
baseline: To meet the goals of the Paris Agreement, India will have to work rapidly on renewable energy.
translation: India needs to ramp up its work on renewable energy to reach the goals of the Paris Agreement.
intended: The author believes India should focus on renewable energy to meet the goals of the Paris Agreement.
label: favor

source: जलवायु परिवर्तन का डर दिखाओ, टैक्स बढ़ाओ, फिर कहो कि यह सब हमारे भले के लिए है। वाह रे सरकार!
baseline: Show fear of climate change, raise taxes, then say it's all for our good. Wow, government!
translation: Talk up the fear of climate change, raise taxes, and then claim it's all for our own good.  What a government!
sarcasm_target: governments that use climate change as a justification for raising taxes
intended: The author believes governments are exploiting climate change to raise taxes and doesn't trust their motives.
label: against

source: तापमान में मामूली बदलाव से घबराने की ज़रूरत नहीं है, यह सब प्राकृतिक है।
baseline: There is no need to panic about the slightest change in temperature, it is all natural.
translation: There's no need to worry about a small change in temperature, it's all just natural.
sarcasm_target: people who panic about climate change
intended: The author believes climate change is not a serious issue and that fluctuations in temperature are normal.
label: against

source: विकसित देश खुद प्रदूषण करते रहे, अब भारत को उपदेश दे रहे हैं। हम कोयला इस्तेमाल करना बंद नहीं करेंगे।
baseline: Developed countries themselves kept polluting, now preaching to India. We will not stop using coal.
translation: Developed countries kept polluting, and now they're lecturing India? We won't stop using coal.
intended: The author believes developed countries are hypocritical for criticizing India's coal use and that India will continue to use coal.
label: against

source: जलवायु संकट का रोना रोने वाले ज़रा बताएँ, इस जनवरी की कड़ाके की ठंड में गर्मी कहाँ छुपी है?
baseline: For those crying out about the climate crisis, just tell me, where is the heat hiding in this January's bitter cold?
translation: You climate crisis worriers, tell me this: where is all that heat hiding in this January's freezing cold?
sarcasm_target: people who express concern about climate change
intended: The author believes climate change is not a serious issue, and may be skeptical of its existence.
label: against

source: इलेक्ट्रिक गाड़ियाँ कोई समाधान नहीं हैं, यह सिर्फ़ कंपनियों का मुनाफ़ा बढ़ाने का तरीका है।
baseline: Electric cars are not a solution, they are just a way for companies to increase their profits.
translation: Electric cars aren't the solution, they're just a way for companies to make more money.
intended: The author thinks electric cars are a marketing ploy by companies rather than a genuine solution to climate change.
label: against

source: धरती खुद को ठंडा-गरम करती रहती है, इंसान इतना ताक़तवर नहीं कि मौसम बदल दे।
baseline: The earth keeps cooling and warming itself; humans are not powerful enough to change the weather.
translation: The Earth naturally cools and warms itself; humans aren't powerful enough to change the weather.
intended: The author believes humans don't have a significant impact on climate change.
label: against

source: कोयला मंत्रालय ने नई खदानों की नीलामी की तारीख़ तय की।
baseline: The Ministry of Coal fixed the date for auction of new mines.
translation: The Ministry of Coal has set the date for the auction of new coal mines.
intended: The author states a factual event and does not express an opinion on it.
label: neutral

source: मैं अभी जलवायु परिवर्तन पर पढ़ रहा हूँ, मुझे अभी तय नहीं है कि इस पर क्या सोचूँ।
baseline: I'm reading up on climate change right now, I'm not sure what to think about it yet.
translation: I'm reading about climate change right now, I haven't decided what to think about it yet.
intended: The author is currently undecided about climate change.
label: neutral

source: पुस्तक मेले में जलवायु विषय पर कई किताबें उपलब्ध हैं।
baseline: Several books on climate are available at the book fair.
translation: There are many books on climate change available at the book fair.
intended: The author is stating a fact about the availability of books on climate change.
label: neutral

source: नई दिल्ली में इलेक्ट्रिक बसों की संख्या बढ़ाई जाएगी।
baseline: The number of electric buses will be increased in New Delhi.
translation: The number of electric buses is going to be increased in New Delhi.
intended: The author states a factual claim about an increase in electric buses in New Delhi.
label: neutral

source: कृषि विभाग किसानों को सूखा-रोधी बीज बाँटेगा।
baseline: The Agriculture Department will distribute drought-resistant seeds to farmers.
translation: The Agriculture Department will distribute drought-resistant seeds to farmers.
intended: The author states a fact about the Agriculture Department's plan to distribute drought-resistant seeds.
label: neutral

source: आज सुबह कोहरे की वजह से कई ट्रेनें देरी से चल रही हैं।
baseline: Several trains are running late due to fog this morning.
translation: Many trains are running late today due to the fog.
intended: The author is stating a fact about delayed trains caused by fog.
label: neutral

source: আজ নির্গমন না কমালে আগামীকাল অনেক দেরি হয়ে যাবে।
baseline: If we don't reduce emissions today, it will be too late tomorrow.
translation: If we don't cut emissions today, it will be far too late tomorrow.
intended: The author believes climate change is a serious threat and urges immediate action to reduce emissions.
label: favor

source: আমি তরুণদের জলবায়ু মিছিলকে সমর্থন করি, তাদের কণ্ঠস্বর শোনা উচিত।
baseline: I support youth climate marches, their voices should be heard.
translation: I support the young people's climate marches; their voices need to be heard.
intended: The author believes young people's voices on climate change are important and deserves to be heard.
label: favor

source: সবচেয়ে ঠান্ডা দিনে এক টুকরো বরফ দেখিয়ে প্রমাণ করে দিল বিশ্ব উষ্ণায়ন নাকি ভুয়া, ধন্য বিজ্ঞানী মশাই!
baseline: A piece of ice on the coldest day proved global warming or a fake, blessed scientist mosquito!
translation: Showing a piece of ice on the coldest day proves global warming is a lie, thank you, brilliant scientist!
sarcasm_target: the idea that global warming is a hoax
intended: The author believes global warming is real and mocks the idea that it is a hoax.
label: favor

source: #ClimateAction এখন সময়ের দাবি, আমাদের আর কোনো দ্বিতীয় পৃথিবী নেই।
baseline: Climate action is the need of the hour, we no longer have a second world.
translation: Climate action is crucial right now; we don't have a second planet.
intended: The author believes climate change is a serious problem and that immediate action is needed.
label: favor

source: ৪৭ ডিগ্রিতে ঘেমে নেয়ে যাচ্ছি, অথচ কেউ কেউ বলছে বিশ্ব উষ্ণায়ন মিথ্যা। দারুণ!
baseline: Soaking in 47 degrees, while some say global warming is a lie. Great!
translation: It's 47 degrees out, and I'm melting, but some people say global warming is a lie. Fantastic!
intended: The author believes global warming is real and ridicules those who deny it.
label: favor

source: শহর জলে ডুবে আছে, কিন্তু না না, এটা জলবায়ু পরিবর্তন নয়, শুধু 'স্বাভাবিক আবহাওয়া'।
baseline: The city is under water, but no, it's not climate change, just'normal weather '.
translation: The city is flooded, but no, no, it's not climate change, it's just "normal weather".
intended: The author believes climate change is real and is causing the flooding; stance on climate change is that it is real and serious.
label: favor

source: কয়লার বদলে সৌরশক্তি ব্যবহার করতে হবে, নইলে আমাদের সন্তানরা আমাদের ক্ষমা করবে না।
baseline: Solar energy should be used instead of coal, otherwise our children will not forgive us.
translation: We need to use solar energy instead of coal, or our children will never forgive us.
intended: The author believes we should switch to solar energy to combat climate change and prevent harming future generations.
label: favor

source: কার্বন নির্গমন কমানো এখন আর বিকল্প নয়, বাধ্যবাধকতা।
baseline: Reducing carbon emissions is no longer an option, but an obligation.
translation: Reducing carbon emissions isn't an option anymore, it's a necessity.
intended: The author believes reducing carbon emissions is essential and urgent.
label: favor

source: পরিবেশকর্মীরা শুধু উন্নয়নের শত্রু, ওদের কথায় কান দেবেন না।
baseline: Environmental activists are just enemies of development, don't listen to them.
translation: Environmental activists are just against development, don't listen to them.
intended: The author believes environmental activists are hindering progress and opposes their message.
label: against

source: তাপমাত্রার সামান্য পরিবর্তনে ঘাবড়ানোর কিছু নেই, এটা সবই প্রাকৃতিক।
baseline: The slightest change in temperature is nothing to panic about, it's all natural.
translation: A little change in temperature is nothing to worry about, it's all just natural.
sarcasm_target: people who are concerned about climate change
intended: The author believes climate change is not a serious issue and dismisses concerns about it.
label: against

source: বিশ্ব উষ্ণায়ন একটা বড় ষড়যন্ত্র, আর লোকে না ভেবেই তা মেনে নেয়।
baseline: Global warming is a big conspiracy, and people accept it without thinking.
translation: Global warming is a huge conspiracy, and people just blindly accept it.
sarcasm_target: the idea that global warming is a conspiracy
intended: The author believes global warming is a fabricated issue, not a real phenomenon.
label: against

source: কয়লা আমাদের প্রয়োজন, জলবায়ুর নামে তা বন্ধ করা বোকামি হবে।
baseline: We need coal, it would be foolish to shut it down in the name of climate.
translation: We need coal; shutting it down for the sake of climate is just stupid.
intended: The author believes coal is essential and opposes climate action that would restrict its use.
label: against

source: জলবায়ু সংকটের কান্না যাঁরা কাঁদেন, তাঁরা একটু বলুন তো, এই জানুয়ারির কনকনে শীতে গরমটা লুকিয়ে আছে কোথায়?
baseline: For those who weep over the climate crisis, tell me, where is the heat hiding in this January's cold?
translation: Those who are crying over the climate crisis, tell me, where's the heat hiding in this January's frigid cold?
sarcasm_target: people who complain about climate change without acknowledging current weather patterns
intended: The author believes climate change is not a current concern because it is cold, implying the author is skeptical of climate change.
label: against

source: জলবায়ু সম্মেলনে শুধু পিকনিক হয়, ফল কিছুই আসে না, সবই বাজে কথা।
baseline: There are only picnics at climate conferences, there are no results, it's all crap.
translation: Climate conferences are just picnics, nothing gets done, it's all talk.
sarcasm_target: climate conferences and their lack of action
intended: The author believes climate conferences are ineffective and pointless.
label: against

source: বৈঠকে জলবায়ু তহবিল নিয়ে আলোচনা হয়েছে, তবে চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত হয়নি।
baseline: Climate funding was discussed at the meeting, but a final decision has not been made.
translation: Climate funding was discussed at the meeting, but no final decision was reached.
intended: The author is reporting on a meeting where climate funding was discussed, but no conclusions were drawn.
label: neutral

source: বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় জলবায়ু বিজ্ঞানে নতুন কোর্স চালু করেছে।
baseline: The university has introduced new courses in climate science.
translation: The university has started new courses in climate science.
intended: The author is stating a fact about a new university course.
label: neutral

source: আবহাওয়া দপ্তর আগামী তিন দিনে ভারী বৃষ্টির সতর্কতা জারি করেছে।
baseline: The Meteorological Department has predicted heavy rain for three more days in the state.
translation: The Meteorological Department has issued a warning of heavy rain for the next three days.
intended: The author is relaying information about a weather forecast.
label: neutral

source: এই প্রতিবেদন অনুযায়ী গত বছর কার্বন নির্গমন তিন শতাংশ বেড়েছে।
baseline: According to this report, carbon emissions rose by three percent last year.
translation: This report says carbon emissions went up by three percent last year.
intended: The author is stating a fact about rising carbon emissions.
label: neutral

source: আজ সকালে কুয়াশার কারণে বেশ কিছু ট্রেন দেরিতে চলছে।
baseline: Several trains are running late due to fog this morning.
translation: Several trains are running late this morning because of the fog.
intended: The author is stating a factual observation about train delays caused by fog; stance on climate change unclear.
label: neutral

source: শহরে নতুন পার্ক উদ্বোধন হয়েছে, সেখানে পাঁচশো গাছ লাগানো হয়েছে।
baseline: New parks have been opened in the city, five hundred trees have been planted there.
translation: A new park has been opened in the city, with five hundred trees planted there.
intended: The author is simply stating a fact about a new park and tree planting. Stance on climate change unclear.
label: neutral
